test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following received the Padma Vibhushan for the year 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**George Fernandes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In two civil investiture ceremonies held at the Rashtrapati Bhavan,** former Union ministers George Fernandes, Arun Jaitley, and Sushma Swaraj, **as well as former President of Mauritius **Anerood Jugnauth**, were posthumously awarded the Padma Vibhushan for their outstanding and distinguished service.
 
• For the years 2020 and 2021**, seven Padma Vibhushan awards, sixteen Padma Bhushan awards, and 122 Padma Shri **awards were given out.
 
• The Padma awards are presented in three categories: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri, and are announced on the eve of Republic Day each year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **George Mathew Fernandes** was the **22nd Defence Minister of India**, serving from 1998 to 2004. 
 
• **Bachendri Pal** is an Indian mountaineer who made history by becoming the first Indian woman to summit Mount Everest in **1984**.
 
• **S. Nambi Narayanan **worked at the Indian Space Research Organisation as an aerospace engineer.
 
• **Mohanlal Viswanathan **is an Indian actor, film producer, playback singer, television personality, and film distributor who is most known for his work in Malayalam films, though he has also acted in Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Hindi films.
